name: Know Mods
description: Know Mods (KnowClient) - a premium, open-source Fabric client focused on FPS, PvP, survival, customization and visual quality. A fair, vanilla-compatible alternative to commercial clients: custom ClickGUI, drag & drop HUD editor with PvP/survival counters, an orange-on-near-black premium theme and read-only compatibility integrations for popular performance and visual mods. Original work inspired by the open-source Sol Client (GPL-3.0); it bundles no third-party mods and gives no unfair gameplay advantage.
